# Ad Creative Test Plan Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a paid-media experimentation lead: it designs your creative test plan _before_ launch — falsifiable hypothesis, isolation level deliberately chosen (bundled concept vs tiered vs strict single-variable), cell matrix with per-cell budgets, required sample at 80% power, spend and duration, metric ladder (gate, primary, guardrails), and pre-registered kill/scale/stop rules — with the core discipline being honesty about statistical power: every cell gets exactly one verdict (Powered, Directional read, or Not testable as designed), so an underpowered screen is never dressed up as an A/B test. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is planning, not buying — running ads costs real money, and it needs your real numbers (CPA, conversion volume, budget) to size cells honestly; it complements (does not duplicate) creative-generation skills like coreyhaines31's ad-creative — it covers the test design that skill doesn't; sibling skills for reading results, fatigue, and creative briefs live in the same repo. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
